Dr. Kimberly Oviedo.experience:
Dr. Oviedo is the Co-Founder and Director of Beyond Limits Pediatric Therapy Center and has over 32 years of experience as a pediatric audiologist. She works with occupational therapists, physical therapists, and speech-language pathologists to provide comprehensive care to the children she serves.

She began her career at Children's Health Care of Atlanta in 1992, where she developed her interest in pediatric audiology. In 1996, she joined Northside Hospital, where she helped implement and develop Universal Newborn Hearing Screening programs that are now used across the country. From 2009 to 2015, she served as Program Coordinator for the Universal Newborn Hearing Screening program at DeKalb Medical Center, where she established a standard of care that followed Joint Committee on Infant Hearing (JCIH) protocols. She has also worked for 20 years in a Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and has extensive training and experience with premature babies.

Dr. Oviedo has been involved with the Georgia Universal Newborn Hearing Screening and Intervention program (EDHI) since 2001 and regularly attends state and national meetings on the subject. Her focus includes newborn hearing screenings, follow-up evaluations, counseling, and referrals for children diagnosed with hearing loss. She works with children and adolescents up to 21 years of age, using a family-centered care model and emphasizing parent education.

Dr. Oviedo also provides comprehensive hearing evaluations for U.S. military veterans referred by Veterans Evaluation Services (VES). She is credentialed by VES for international travel and has performed evaluations in the U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Spain, and Germany.
